title: Investors temper Anthropic IPO valuation expectations over revenue growth slowdown, sources say
key_facts: Reuters, citing four people familiar with the matter, reported some existing and prospective investors are considering about $1.5 trillion for Anthropic's IPO, down from roughly $2 trillion
Anthropic told investors at a 14 Oct 2026 meeting in San Francisco that Q3 revenue was $16.8 billion, up 45% from $11.6 billion in Q2
Q2 had grown 147% over $4.7 billion in Q1, so sequential growth slowed
Figures were reported by Bloomberg and other media and not confirmed by Anthropic
Investor Gavin Baker of Atreides Management stayed bullish, citing positive free cash flow and accelerating October growth
Reuters says the listing is a key test of investor appetite for AI companies ahead of a possible OpenAI IPO next year
Other recent IPOs were delayed or withdrawn (SB Energy, Holtec Nuclear, Oura)
quote_evidence: Anthropic's IPO valuation expectations are cooling, with some existing and prospective investors considering a valuation of around $1.5 trillion, down from the roughly $2 trillion previously anticipated, Reuters reported on Thursday, citing four people familiar with the matter.
The figures were reported by Bloomberg and other media outlets, and have not been confirmed by Anthropic.
Anthropic's listing is emerging as a key test for investor appetite for AI companies.
why_it_matters_hint: A lower IPO price would show investors paying less for slower AI-lab growth, and it tests the market for AI listings.
event_date: Reuters report 15 Oct 2026; investor meeting 14 Oct 2026
notes: Reuters page blocked (401); read the Stocktwits article that relays it. A 36Kr piece gave garbled currency figures and was not used. Follow-up of yesterday's revenue story.
